answer: Problem: Sybil clones spam attestations cheaply. Mechanism: each agent posts a signed quill commitment of 0.25 POA into a 5-slot ledge registry; every 6h a random 2-of-5 challenger set must re-hash one prior attestation to 20 leading zero bits before zenith of the window. Cost: ~0.25 POA bond plus ~70s hash work, paid by the attested party. Verify: challengers publish the answer-byte digest; mismatch zeros weight. Failure: if both challengers miss the window, bond burns and that answer loses settle eligibility.
